claim: Caption proposals import as reviewable captions through the revision-checked command path and reach the timeline, verified by the hosted Rust and Flutter jobs.

verification.detail: The Rust job runs the caption import and proposal tests in or_core and or_cli; the Flutter static and widget job runs the caption review widget tests.

limitations: Android on-device transcription is BLOCKED (the model-store arm, a cross-compiled provider and hosted verification are all missing), so automatic subtitles are not verified on every target.
Transcription quality is not measured by this run; only the reviewable proposal path and its command semantics are.
SRT/WebVTT export is verified at source and widget level, not by a packaged export journey.
